decisions.reason: A reference electrometer close to the core dosimetry offer is featured on the home page in both years, which signals results that meet aspiration, so there is no trigger for search.

The oncology risk management software builds on the established QA software, keeps its own page in its second year, and fits the strategy of integrated, predictive QA, and the expanding firm has the slack to carry its uncertain software results.
A CT image quality phantom extends the firm's imaging QA line, is newly presented on its own page, and is too early to judge below aspiration, so slack from growth supports keeping it.

The mammography phantom lies farther from the core business and carries more uncertainty, but there is no evidence of a shortfall after one year and an expanding firm has slack to keep it while results develop.

The full field mammography phantom is distant and may overlap with Product D, which raises the chance of consolidation, but as a new launch with no reported shortfall and ample slack it is likely retained for now.
The broad imaging QA instrument line builds on established competencies, supports the firm's push into medical imaging QA, and shows no sign of results below aspiration.
